adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` includes `organizer`, `attendees`, etc., but never sets `evt.team` (or any team member list). In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (`packages/emails/email-manager.ts`), the team-member notification logic is guarded by `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`, so without `calEvent.team` being present, that loop will never execute and additional team hosts won’t receive the organizer notification email. This is directly verifiable from the diff.
